quality_constraints.channels: all of ['dwi', 'adc', 'flair'] are required; missing sequences are refused, not zero-filled

temporal_validation: not applicable — cross-sectional imaging cohort, no index or outcome time

preprocessing.reduction: PCA to qubit count at the quantum boundary

calibration.note: Operating threshold selected on the validation split only (target_sensitivity@0.8 (validation only)). safety.disclaimer: Research characterisation estimate from imaging. Not a diagnosis and not a medical device.
limitations: Research use only, not a medical device
Labels derived from expert lesion masks, not prospective radiologist measurement
Single public cohort, no external site validation
DAWN 21 mL threshold; DEFUSE-3 uses 70 mL
Cohort size 250 — see research record for confidence intervals.
No external-site or multi-cohort validation has been performed.
Calibration (reliability/ECE) is not assessed; the score is a thresholded decision value.

model_card.intended_use: Research benchmarking of a hybrid quantum-classical characterisation model on MR for neuro.stroke.ischemic.acute.
model_card.excluded_use: Any clinical use. Diagnosis. Triage of real patients.
model_card.evaluation_population: Stratified held-out split of the same cohort. No external cohort.
